payload.claim: DESIGN.md §5.1's sketch still shows a one-time `saffron-cells` network created with `--subnet 10.88.0.0/24`. After this change a task's cells network is allocated per task from the `10.200.0.0/16` pool, so this authoritative, spec-cited example no longer matches what the code does. The spec's own notes acknowledge this and defer the doc update to the operator, so this is already known rather than hidden, but it is worth recording since DESIGN.md section numbers are cited by other specs as a stable contract.
